priorFailure.symptom: Drizzle relational findMany with invoice relation generated LEFT JOIN LATERAL + json_build_array over full invoices row; query failed on staging during importPaymentBatch

rootCause: importPaymentBatch and syncPayments used db.query.xeroInvoiceMappings.findMany({ with: { invoice: true } }), which emits a lateral join selecting every invoices column. Staging schema drift or Drizzle lateral JSON assembly caused the payments-stage lookup to fail before any payment rows were processed.

fix.change: Replace relational lateral-join query with explicit innerJoin on xero_invoice_mappings + invoices, selecting only payment-sync fields (currency, amountPaidCents, amountCents, status, invoiceNumber). Shared via loadSyncedInvoiceMappingsForPayments and buildSyncedInvoiceMappingLookup.
fix.test: apps/api/src/services/xero-import-sync.test.ts — buildSyncedInvoiceMappingLookup indexes synced rows by xero invoice id

stagingSafety.note: Code fix only; deploy allows active job to resume through payments without manual sync or DB mutation
